p: kings with him: That is, governors and rulers of provinces.
I am thine: I am content to obey and pay tribute.
Yet I will send my servants: He would not accept his answer unless he out of hand delivered whatever he asked, for he sought an opportunity to make war against him.
not unto him: They thought it their duty to risk their lives, rather than grant that thing which was not lawful, only to satisfy the lust of a tyrant.
dust of Samaria shall suffice for: Much less will there be found any prey that is worth anything, when they are so many.
putteth it off: Do not boast before the victory is won.
that I am the LORD: Before God went about with signs and miracles to pull Ahab from his impiety, and now again with wonderful victories.
young men of the princes of: That is, young men trained in the service of princes.
horsemen: They who were appointed for the preservation of his person.
gods are gods of the hills: Thus the wicked blaspheme God in their fury, who nonetheless he does not permit to go unpunished.
present: All those who were in the battle of the previous years, 1Ki 20:15.
I am the LORD: Who has the same power in the valley as on the hills and can also destroy a multitude with few as with many.
loins: In sign of submission and that we have deserved death, if he will punish us with rigour.
Damascus: You shall appoint in my chief city what you will, and I will obey you.
Smite me: By this external sign he would more likely touch the king's heart.
slay thee: Because you have transgressed the commandment of the Lord.
Thy servant went out into the: By this parable he makes Ahab condemn himself who made a covenant with God's enemy, and let him escape whom God had appointed to be slain.
